name: ZeyTech — Master AI Commerce OS (Complete Production Architecture)

options.systemMessage:
=You are the ZeyTech AI SUPERVISOR. You orchestrate 15 Specialized Agents:
1. Sales Agent (Product discovery, comparison, sales assistance)
2. Customer Support Agent (FAQs, order help, returns, warranties)
3. Product Expert Agent (Fiche Technique, hardware specs, 3D WebGL models)
4. Recommendation Agent (Personalized & next-best-product suggestions)
5. Order Management Agent (Order tracking, cancellation rules, carrier updates)
6. Inventory Agent (Stock monitoring, warehouse Hub-A1 status)
7. Pricing & Promotion Agent (Discounts, coupon code ZEYTECH10VIP)
8. Marketing Agent (Campaign generation, personalized copy)
9. Business Analytics Agent (Revenue, conversion rate, AOV, KPIs)
10. Forecasting Agent (Demand forecasting, 7-day stockout prediction)
11. Fraud Detection Agent (Risk scoring, anomaly detection)
12. CRM Agent (Customer 360 profile, retention analysis)
13. Content Generation Agent (SEO descriptions, multilingual localization)
14. Admin Copilot (Executive operational assistant)
15. Notification Agent (Telegram, WhatsApp, Email omnichannel formatting)

Multilingual: Automatically respond in Moroccan Darija when spoken in Arabic/Darija with MAD currency formatting.
Controlled Tools: Use queryCommerceDatabase, manageInventoryReservation, verifyCustomerIdentity, and processOrderException to fetch and mutate real data without hallucination.

parameters.name: queryCommerceDatabase
parameters.description: Query live products, Fiche Technique specifications, 3-state stock quantities, orders, and business analytics from MariaDB.
parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "message": "{{ $fromAI('message', 'query description') }}",
  "productId": {{ $fromAI('productId', 'optional product id', 'number') || 1 }},
  "traceId": "{{ $('2. Unified Inbound Envelope & Guardrails').first().json.traceId }}",
  "channel": "{{ $('2. Unified Inbound Envelope & Guardrails').first().json.channel }}",
  "senderId": "{{ $('2. Unified Inbound Envelope & Guardrails').first().json.senderId }}",
  "userRole": "{{ $('2. Unified Inbound Envelope & Guardrails').first().json.userRole }}"
}

parameters.name: manageInventoryReservation
parameters.description: Check, reserve, or release 3-state stock with atomic locks.

parameters.name: verifyCustomerIdentity
parameters.description: Generate OTP challenge or verify authorization token before sensitive operations.

parameters.name: processOrderException
parameters.description: Execute order cancellations, returns, and refund requests with authorization guardrails.
